brief.zh: 用 OpenCV 处理校准板，让亮度阈值选出两个互不相连的区域。
brief.en: Process the calibration board with OpenCV and tune the threshold to keep two separate regions.

concept.zh: 阈值改变时，白色像素数和连通区域数都会变化。
concept.en: Changing the threshold changes the white pixels and the connected regions.

hints.zh: 115 会留下三个区域，180 只留下一个。试试中间的值。
hints.en: 115 keeps three regions and 180 keeps one. Try a value between them.

prompt.zh: 调整亮度阈值，让 OpenCV 数到恰好 2 个白色区域。
prompt.en: Adjust the brightness threshold until OpenCV counts exactly two white regions.
